title: Accounting
subtitle: The books, posted from the POS: chart of accounts, entries, reports and the SAF-T (AO) accounting file.
readOnly: You can look at the books; only the owner changes them.

setup.offDescription: Switch accounting on to get the chart of accounts (PGC), the entries posted automatically from sales, purchases and payments, the reports and the annual SAF-T (AO) accounting file.
setup.disabledNote: Accounting is off: nothing is posted. Everything already in the books is kept.
setup.startDateHint: Earlier documents are not posted: they are in the opening balances.
setup.cashPerTillHint: Otherwise all cash goes to 45.1.1 Caixa principal.
setup.groupingHint: Daily summary: Facturas-Recibo, credit notes and receipts are added up per till and day (once the day is over). Invoices on credit and purchases are always one entry each.
setup.purchasesFile: Monthly SAF-T purchases file (Aquisição de Bens e Serviços)

purchasesFiles.AUTO: Automatic: remind me while e-invoicing is off

chart.templateNote: Default chart: Plano Geral de Contabilidade (Decreto 82/01) — to be validated by an accountant.
chart.name: Name
chart.addHint: The code goes under its parent: 75.2.9.1 is a sub-account of 75.2.9.
chart.sync: Open missing customer, supplier and till accounts
